verses.4021: ʾashkū ʾilā llāhi mā bil-qalbi min ḥazani wamā ʾuqāṣī bihi min maḍjaʿi khashini
verses.4022: ʾanfaqtu kanza madārātī linayli salā mahi walam yughni shayʾā fī banī zamanī
verses.4023: lawlā l-murūʾatu ʾukhtu d-dīni mā nbasaṭat rūḥī ʾilā ʾaḥadi khawfā mina l-fitani
verses.4024: walā ʾukhāliṭu man yardā biṣuḥbatihi dīnī wadunyāyā min ghishshi wamin dakhani
verses.4025: mā ziltu ʾāmulu dhā wuddi yuwāfiqunī bihi ʾurāmiqu wuddī ghayra muḍṭaghini
verses.4026: wal-ʾamru bil-ʿaksi ʾinnī kuntu fī sinati waʾayqaẓatnī ẓurūfu d-dahri min wasani
verses.4027: rumtu s-salāmata fānsaddat masālikuhā ʾinna s-salāmata ʾamru ghayru mumtahani
